name: Beccc
bio:
Beccc is the Head of Staff on Silver Springs Survival, helping with server builds, player support, general staff work, and feedback for the design team. She first found Silver Springs in 2014 while looking for a server to play with her boyfriend, after his server refused to whitelist her.

She stayed because the community was so friendly and helpful, especially while she was still learning Minecraft. These days, she enjoys both the community and the custom content.

One of her favorite projects is the Silver Scepter mage college, which she built alongside Autumn_Bun and Mr_Simba. The project was a major undertaking and became an important part of her friendship with Simba.

Beccc also met her real-life husband through Silver Springs, and the two of them now help run the server together. Outside of Minecraft, she enjoys Outer Wilds, Hades, and Stardew Valley.
history: Becc became a Moderator on the 5th of July 2015, then became an Admin on the 18th of March 2016. On January 29, 2019, Becc was promoted to the rank of HoS.
